item.title: Annual Review and Conceptual Development Issue (ARCDI) 2026
item.content:encoded:
This call invites submissions for an Annual Review and Conceptual Development Issue that aims to advance conceptual thinking and provide comprehensive reviews within the field. The issue seeks to compile work that contributes to both theoretical development and state-of-the-art assessments of current knowledge.

Appel publié par Journal of Organizational Behavior. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Timeline

  • February 15, 2027: Submission window opens
  • March 14, 2027: Submission window closes
